Parliament panel warns Meta over PM Modi video removal, seeks apology

A parliamentary panel has issued a three-day ultimatum to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, demanding an apology for the removal of a video featuring Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The panel warned that Meta could lose its safe harbor protection if it fails to comply. A Meta team reportedly admitted to paying for content boosting and expressed regret for mistakes. The panel's chief also alleged that Meta promotes 'anti-democracy' content, citing higher view counts for a group called CJP compared to the BJP.
